approach: Find the apparent frequency while the train approaches and while it recedes, then express their difference as a percentage of the true horn frequency.

steps.text: Convert the train's speed to metres per second.
Write the apparent frequency while approaching and while receding, as a multiple of the true frequency f.
The change in frequency, as a fraction of f, is the difference of these two multiples.
steps.why_this_step: This ratio simplifies to 2v_s·v/(v² − v_s²), the standard result for the total frequency swing during a pass-by.

steps.text: Express this fraction as a percentage.

common_mistakes.text: Dividing the frequency change by the approach frequency instead of the true frequency f, which gives 16.67% instead of 18.33%.
